Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your offer and for your interest in building a long-term partnership with us. We appreciate your commitment to proving yourselves as a reliable supplier; our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you. Could you review your proposal in light of this full-demand commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 6000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:SH-220).
We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 12.55 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days, delivery EXW, for our full demand of 6000 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW.
Please let me explain.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to placing your full demand with us and have carefully reviewed your should-cost analysis and delivery feedback.
We are pleased to accept the 42 days lead time, but we must request to keep the payment terms at 45 days net to support our operations.
In light of these factors and your volume commitment, we can offer a revised price of €15.40 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €15.40 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
